name: Log4Shell
description: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features used in configuration, log messages, and parameters do not protect against attacker-controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints, allowing remote code execution via a crafted log string.

name: XZ Utils Backdoor
description: Malicious code was discovered in the upstream tarballs of xz (liblzma) starting with 5.6.0, introducing a backdoor that can allow remote code execution by interfering with sshd authentication.

name: Heartbleed
description: The TLS heartbeat extension in OpenSSL 1.0.1 before 1.0.1g allows remote attackers to read sensitive memory contents, potentially exposing private keys and credentials.

name: OpenSSH ssh-agent RCE
description: A flaw in the PKCS#11 feature of OpenSSH's ssh-agent allows remote code execution if an agent is forwarded to an attacker-controlled host with specific libraries present.

name: OpenSSL BN_mod_sqrt DoS
description: The BN_mod_sqrt function can be tricked into an infinite loop when parsing a malformed certificate, causing a denial of service.
